goal: Speed up chain activation, reindexing, and initial block download
Overlap disk reads with block validation so nodes do not wait synchronously on disk I/O
agreement: Strong support with independent benchmarking showing reindex and IBD speedups (andrewtoth)
Resolved objection on debug log spamming from thread churn (fanquake)
Resolved objection on invalid branch blocks persisting in memory (w0xlt)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it substantially speeds up chain synchronization and reindex
Benchmarks show up to 1.57x faster reindexing and 1.13x faster initial block download
Node operators on both HDDs and SSDs benefit from reduced sync times
